Venue: Mir

The quiz will feature questions ranging from typography to design and illustration, with prizes for the winning team!

Grafill Graphic Design is once again hosting Quiz+Sip taking place at Mir! The event is open to everyone, whether you're a working professional, student,       or simply a design enthusiast. Bring a friend and join us for a relaxed evening of knowledge and good vibes.

Welcome to the quiz on Thursday, August 6th. The door opens at 7:00 PM, with the quiz starting at 7:30 PM sharp!

Please note that a photographer may be present at some of our events, and photos may be shared on Grafill’s website and social media channels.

Adresse
Mir, Toftes Gate 69

entry.content:
Venue: Mir
Start: 2026-10-01 19:00
Tags: Show, Burlesque, Gitarsolo


Take a walk on the wild side 👈 A quintet of the most dazzling performers around will gather for a one night only extraordinary variety-act - Cabaret Glans. A night of burlesque, sideshow, opera, contemporary-circus-dance, rock-n-roll, depravity, insanity and of course plenty of sensuality. All with new music written for the occasion and performed live. Our quintet of shockingly attractive talents consists of: The first ever Ukrainian burlesque-performer, the absolute star "Miss Mistress". Coming all the way from Poland to dazzle us with her classic and jaw dropping burlesque. Norway's no. 1 fakir and sideshow performer "Morten the Maniac". A true veteran of pain and danger combined with nothing but the finest of showmanship. Lyric-baritone opera-extraordinaire "Matcha Forte" usually spends his time lounging in Italian castles between his performances of Verdi and Puccini across international opera stages. But tonight only he is stepping down from the castle staircase to bless us kids of the underground with his mighty champagne voice. Zelda can be seen tumbling through the air, posing in impossible positions or rolling around on the floor in the most experimental contemporary productions. As our very own contemporary-dance-circus-acrobatics-performer she delights us with the artistic flair we so dearly need - both in our cabaret and the world as a whole. The show is led by the prince of the underground - Kapellmeister Glans. Stinking up both punk-squats and concert halls with his intense compositions. Our kapellmeister and MC will guide us through the evening with equal parts whimsical absurdity and razor-sharp aesthetical precision. And of course perform all the cabaret's music live with electric guitar and live-electronics. Tonight only - you don't want to miss this - Pre-book your tickets to make sure we dont throw you out at the door. ALL THE MONEY GOES TO THE PERFORMERS. Available soon! Dress code: Dress to impress, tonight is the night to go full cabaret!

Adr: Toftesgt 69 MIR opens 19:00 ID: 20
